dataSource: City of Detroit BSEED (Buildings, Safety, Engineering & Environmental Dept) building permits (ArcGIS open data), queried live
notes: Pulled live from Detroit's own ArcGIS open data feed on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search.
Matched by house number plus the first word of the street name; results may occasionally include unrelated records that happen to share both.
Permit status is not tracked in this dataset and will not appear; permit date, permit number, permit type, and description are all reliably populated.
Data may have limited coverage for older permits, per the city's own data notice.
summary: Detroit is covered by a live query against the city's public BSEED building permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
